title: Match browser error expectations
responsibility: Classify observed browser errors and retain expectations that were not observed.

inputs.name: browserErrorRows.diagnostic
inputs.description: One test attempt's recorded console error messages and uncaught page exceptions (errors) and its declared expectations (expected), read together whenever those errors are classified. An expectation matches an error only when type and message are exactly equal and, when the expectation has a source, the error's source is exactly equal too; line, column, stack and page are never compared.

examples.test: an image that failed to load is rejected as capture evidence

errors.message: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)

errors.stack:
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')
    at renderPreview (http://harness-readiness.test/app.js:12:19)

expected.message: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)
expected.reason: The capture must refuse this intentionally missing image.

outputs.name: browserErrorRows
outputs.description: One row per observed error, in observation order, marked Expected with the matched expectation's reason or Unexpected; each expectation left unused by any error follows as a Missing expected error row. Observed rows keep all fields of their error, Missing rows carry the expectation's fields, and the input diagnostic is not modified.
